verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax provides itemized exports with line-item tax breakdowns, taxability_reason fields explaining the calculation logic, product tax codes, and registration/address data via the API and Dashboard, giving ops users the core building blocks to reconstruct a transaction's tax determination. However, evidence doesn't show a single consolidated audit-trail export combining rate+rule+address+category per transaction in one artifact, nor independent confirmation of long-term retention guarantees. missing for 10: explicit consolidated per-transaction audit record combining all four elements in one export, documented retention/archival period, independent/hands-on verification of export completeness.
